$comment: Open(code)Share plugin config — re:share, session sharing for opencode. Priority: OPENSHARE_* env vars > this file > code defaults. Keys: workerUrl, createToken, debounceMs (default 10000), modelLabel ($Provider/$Model placeholders; literal text sends as-is; empty string hides the model), ttlDays (per-share TTL, capped by the worker), openTasksInNewTab (task rows open subagent pages in a new tab), authLogin/authPassword (optional read gate on the share pages; sent on create AND resume; empty on resume removes protection), spoolDir (temporary unacked-frame buffer; default XDG data home).
